// Package baselineobservation exists only in an attested Go test overlay.
package baselineobservation

import (
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"sync"
)

type HandleEntry struct {
	Key            string `json:"key"`
	HandleIdentity string `json:"handleIdentity"`
}
type LeaseRecord struct {
	Key       string `json:"key"`
	Scope     string `json:"scope"`
	ModelName string `json:"modelName"`
	Status    string `json:"status"`
	Claimed   bool   `json:"claimed"`
}
type HostSnapshot struct {
	Handles     []HandleEntry `json:"handles"`
	HandleCount int           `json:"handleCount"`
}
type LeaseSnapshot struct {
	LeaseRecords         []LeaseRecord  `json:"leaseRecords"`
	LeaseRecordCount     int            `json:"leaseRecordCount"`
	CapacityHolders      map[string]int `json:"capacityHolders"`
	CapacityHoldersTotal int            `json:"capacityHoldersTotal"`
}
type OwnerSnapshot struct {
	Kind          string         `json:"kind"`
	OwnerIdentity string         `json:"ownerIdentity"`
	Source        string         `json:"source"`
	Host          *HostSnapshot  `json:"host,omitempty"`
	Leases        *LeaseSnapshot `json:"leases,omitempty"`
}
type callback struct {
	kind, source string
	read         func() OwnerSnapshot
}

var registry = struct {
	sync.Mutex
	owners   map[string]callback
	failures []error
}{owners: make(map[string]callback)}

func Register(kind, identity, source string, read func() OwnerSnapshot) {
	registry.Lock()
	defer registry.Unlock()
	if identity == "" || source == "" || read == nil || (kind != "instance_host" && kind != "models_leases") {
		registry.failures = append(registry.failures, fmt.Errorf("invalid owner registration %q", identity))
		return
	}
	if _, exists := registry.owners[identity]; exists {
		registry.failures = append(registry.failures, fmt.Errorf("duplicate owner registration %q", identity))
		return
	}
	registry.owners[identity] = callback{kind, source, read}
}

func readOwner(identity string, cb callback) (snapshot OwnerSnapshot, err error) {
	defer func() {
		if failure := recover(); failure != nil {
			err = fmt.Errorf("read owner %s: %v", identity, failure)
		}
	}()
	snapshot = cb.read()
	if snapshot.Kind != cb.kind || snapshot.OwnerIdentity != identity || snapshot.Source != cb.source {
		return OwnerSnapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("owner %s returned inconsistent attribution", identity)
	}
	if cb.kind == "instance_host" && (snapshot.Host == nil || snapshot.Leases != nil) || cb.kind == "models_leases" && (snapshot.Leases == nil || snapshot.Host != nil) {
		return OwnerSnapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("owner %s returned incomplete state", identity)
	}
	return snapshot, nil
}

func CaptureOwner(identity string) (OwnerSnapshot, error) {
	registry.Lock()
	cb, exists := registry.owners[identity]
	registry.Unlock()
	if !exists {
		return OwnerSnapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("owner %s unavailable", identity)
	}
	return readOwner(identity, cb)
}

// Capture releases the collector mutex before acquiring any owner's mutex.
// Cross-owner coherence requires the caller's quiescent lifecycle barrier.
func Capture() ([]OwnerSnapshot, error) {
	registry.Lock()
	owners := make(map[string]callback, len(registry.owners))
	for identity, cb := range registry.owners {
		owners[identity] = cb
	}
	failures := append([]error(nil), registry.failures...)
	registry.Unlock()
	if len(failures) != 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("registration failed: %v", failures)
	}
	if len(owners) == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no owners registered; inventory unavailable")
	}
	keys := make([]string, 0, len(owners))
	for identity := range owners {
		keys = append(keys, identity)
	}
	sort.Strings(keys)
	snapshots := make([]OwnerSnapshot, 0, len(keys))
	for _, identity := range keys {
		snapshot, err := readOwner(identity, owners[identity])
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		snapshots = append(snapshots, snapshot)
	}
	return snapshots, nil
}

func Unregister(identity string) {
	registry.Lock()
	delete(registry.owners, identity)
	registry.Unlock()
}

// Close releases observer references only. Product state is never changed.
func Close() {
	registry.Lock()
	registry.owners = make(map[string]callback)
	registry.failures = nil
	registry.Unlock()
}
